summary: Kimi Antonelli arrives at Circuit of the Americas with pole position and a chance to become Formula 1's youngest world champion, but faces a resurgent Charles Leclerc and a track deteriorated by dangerous bumps that have drawn complaints from Max Verstappen. Mercedes and Ferrari will wage a fierce strategic battle over tire management and pit-stop timing on a circuit that has already shown unpredictable grip levels across Friday practice sessions. A championship-clinching victory for Antonelli would reshape the sport's future and potentially decide the drivers' title fight with multiple races still remaining.
